pages.termsIntro: Welcome to LuggageShare. By using our platform, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
pages.termsEligibility: You must be at least 18 years old to use LuggageShare. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account.
pages.termsServices: LuggageShare connects travelers with spare luggage capacity to senders who need to deliver items. We act as a platform facilitator, not a logistics company.
pages.termsBookings: When a booking is confirmed, both parties agree to follow through. Cancellations should be made with reasonable notice. Repeated cancellations may result in account restrictions.
pages.termsPayments: Payments are processed securely through the platform. Carriers receive payment after successful delivery confirmation. LuggageShare charges a service fee on each transaction.
pages.termsProhibited: Users must not transport prohibited, illegal, or dangerous items. Both carriers and senders are responsible for ensuring compliance with local and international regulations.
pages.termsLiability: LuggageShare is not liable for items lost, damaged, or delayed during transport. We encourage all users to communicate clearly and use the platform's insurance options when available.
pages.termsTermination: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in fraudulent behavior.
pages.termsChanges: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
pages.termsContact: If you have questions about these terms, contact us at support@luggageshare.com
pages.privacyIntro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
pages.privacyCollect: We collect information you provide directly: name, email, phone number, and profile photo. We also collect usage data such as booking history and chat messages.
pages.privacyUse: We use your data to provide and improve our services, process bookings and payments, send notifications, and ensure platform safety.
pages.privacySharing: We do not sell your personal data. We share limited information with other users only as needed for bookings (e.g., carrier sees sender's name and item details).
pages.privacySecurity: We use industry-standard security measures including encryption, secure storage, and access controls to protect your data.
pages.privacyRights: You can access, update, or delete your personal data at any time through your profile settings. You may also request a full data export.
pages.privacyCookies: We use essential cookies for authentication and preferences. No third-party tracking cookies are used.
pages.privacyRetention: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. After account deletion, data is removed within 30 days.
pages.privacyContact: For privacy questions, contact us at privacy@luggageshare.com
pages.contactIntro: We'd love to hear from you. Whether you have a question, feedback, or need help, reach out through any of the channels below.
pages.contactEmailDesc: For general inquiries and support. We typically respond within 24 hours.
pages.contactHoursValue: Sunday – Thursday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Arabia Standard Time)
pages.aboutIntro: LuggageShare is a Saudi-based platform that connects travelers who have spare luggage space with people who need to send items.
pages.aboutMission: Our mission is to make sending items between cities affordable, convenient, and community-driven. Instead of expensive courier services, why not share space with someone already traveling your route?
pages.aboutHow: Travelers post their upcoming trips and available luggage capacity. Senders browse trips, request bookings, and coordinate directly with carriers through our secure chat. After delivery, both parties rate each other to build trust in the community.
pages.aboutValues: We believe in trust, transparency, and community. Every user goes through identity verification, and our review system helps maintain a safe and reliable platform.
pages.aboutTeam: Built by a small team in Riyadh, we're passionate about solving everyday logistics challenges through peer-to-peer sharing.
pages.howItWorksIntro: LuggageShare makes it easy to send items between cities. Here's how:
pages.howStep1Desc: Traveling soon? Post your trip details — departure, destination, date, and available luggage space. Set your price per kg.
pages.howStep2Desc: Need to send something? Browse available trips, find a carrier heading your way, and send a booking request with your item details.
pages.howStep3Desc: Use our secure in-app chat to discuss pickup and delivery details. Share photos of your items for transparency.
pages.howStep4Desc: The carrier delivers the items. Once the sender confirms delivery, the carrier gets paid securely through the platform.
pages.howStep5Desc: Both parties rate each other after delivery. Reviews help build a trusted community.
pages.helpIntro: Find answers to common questions below. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us at support@luggageshare.com.
pages.helpQ1: How do I create an account?
pages.helpA1: Sign in with your Google account. Your profile is created automatically. You can edit your name and add a profile photo from the Profile page.
pages.helpQ2: How do I post a trip?
pages.helpA2: Click 'Add Trip' in the navigation, fill in your route, date, available weight, and price per kg. Review the details and publish.
pages.helpQ3: How do I send an item?
pages.helpA3: Browse available trips on the home page, click on one that matches your route, and send a booking request with your item details and weight.
pages.helpA4: After your booking is accepted, you pay through the platform via bank transfer. Upload a payment receipt as proof. The carrier receives payment after confirming delivery.
pages.helpQ5: What if my item is lost or damaged?
pages.helpA5: Contact us immediately through the app or at support@luggageshare.com. We'll investigate and help resolve the issue. We strongly recommend communicating item details clearly and taking photos before handoff.
pages.helpQ6: How do I cancel a booking?
pages.helpA6: Go to your booking page and cancel from there. Please cancel with reasonable notice. Repeated cancellations may affect your account standing.
pages.safetyIntro: Your safety is our top priority. Here's how we keep the LuggageShare community secure.
pages.safetyVerification: All users sign in with verified Google accounts. We encourage completing your profile with a real photo and name to build trust.
pages.safetyReviews: Our review and rating system lets you see other users' track records before booking. Check ratings and reviews to make informed decisions.
pages.safetyChat: All communication happens through our secure in-app chat. This protects your personal contact info and creates a record of agreements.
pages.safetyPayments: Payments go through the platform, not directly between users. Carriers receive payment only after delivery is confirmed.
pages.safetyTips: Meet in public places for handoffs. Take photos of items before and after. Communicate clearly about item contents. Trust your instincts — if something feels wrong, don't proceed.
pages.safetyReport: If you encounter suspicious behavior, report it immediately through the app or contact support@luggageshare.com. We take all reports seriously.
pages.careersIntro: We're building the future of peer-to-peer luggage sharing. Join our small but ambitious team in Riyadh.
pages.careersWhy: At LuggageShare, you'll work on real problems that affect everyday people. We move fast, ship often, and value ownership. Every team member has a direct impact on the product.
pages.careersCulture: We're a remote-friendly team that values clear communication, continuous learning, and work-life balance. We believe great products come from happy, empowered teams.
pages.careersOpen: We're always looking for talented people in engineering, design, and operations. Even if we don't have an open position listed, we'd love to hear from you.
pages.careersApply: Send your CV and a brief introduction to careers@luggageshare.com
pages.prohibitedIntro: For everyone's safety, the following items are strictly prohibited from being transported through LuggageShare:
pages.prohibitedList1: Explosives, firearms, and weapons of any kind
pages.prohibitedList6: Perishable food items (unless specifically agreed upon)
pages.prohibitedList7: Cash, jewelry, or high-value items over 10,000 SAR
pages.prohibitedList8: Any items prohibited by Saudi Arabian law or the destination country's laws
pages.prohibitedResponsibility: Both the sender and carrier are responsible for ensuring items comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Violations may result in immediate account suspension and legal action.
pages.prohibitedReport: If you suspect a prohibited item is being transported, report it immediately to support@luggageshare.com or through the in-app report feature.
